MachineDefinition.description: The complete released physiology, independent of any particular runtime state.

MemoryLog.description: An append-only log that cannot rewrite MachineDefinition semantics.

RuntimeInstance.description: A concrete application of one immutable MachineDefinition.

RuntimeState.description: The current mutable state of one RuntimeInstance.

invariants: MachineDefinition does not change when RuntimeState changes.
RuntimeInstance cannot reference more than one active MachineDefinition revision.
RuntimeState changes only through transitions declared by the referenced MachineDefinition.
MemoryLog may append and supersede records but cannot amend frozen physiology.
